title: PreprocessingVector v1
description: Descriptor for one synthetic RGB24 scale/pad golden vector. It pairs a reference input plane with the expected output plane and is independent of FixtureMetadata, which describes decoded frame sequences rather than geometry-function pairs. Unknown optional properties are tolerated so the contract can evolve within major version 1.

tooling_schema_version.description: Semantic version of this tooling contract, independent of the observation schemas.

synthetic.description: Deliberately generated provenance. Only synthetic vectors may be committed.

vector_id.description: Stable identifier for the vector within the repository.

output_width.description: Target rectangle width the input is scaled and padded into.

output_height.description: Target rectangle height the input is scaled and padded into.

input_path.description: Repository-relative path of the packed RGB24 input plane.

expected_output_path.description: Repository-relative path of the packed RGB24 plane the reference scale/pad must produce.

description.description: Human-readable summary of the geometry case the vector covers.
